This is a remote opportunity for one of our client.

Roles and Responsibilities :

Forecasting Engine Ownership: Build and maintain production forecasting models (seasonal baselines, regularized regression, LightGBM panel models with conformal calibration, and time-series foundation models) behind a unified interface.

Validation & Rigor: Own walk-forward backtesting, point-in-time (as-of) data correctness, leakage detection, prediction intervals, and hierarchical reconciliation (lane to corridor to index).

Signal Validation & Graph Integration: Run pre-registered signal-validation loops (false-discovery-rate control, bootstrap/placebo checks) and evaluate graph-derived features (centrality, capacity) through the backtest fabric.

AI-Native Engineering: Build and ship production code daily using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor), enforcing CI/CD guardrails, rigorous testing, experiment tracking (MLflow), and clean Git workflows.




Job Requirements :

Experience: 5–8+ years in production time-series/panel forecasting (logistics, freight, or finance background preferred).

Tech Stack: Python, SQL, Pandas/Polars, LightGBM, MLflow, Docker, and APIs.

Statistical Mastery: Walk-forward validation, backtesting, calibration, and hypothesis testing.

AI-Native Workflow: Fluent in orchestrating AI coding agents and reviewing AI-generated code.

Exclusions: No LangChain, RAG, prompt engineering, or generic LLM wrapper profiles.

Design, test and iterate on prompts for LLM-powered products. Build prompt libraries, evaluation frameworks, and chain-of-thought templates. Collaborate with AI architects to optimize model outputs for accuracy and safety. Document prompt strategies and maintain a centralised prompt repository. Research emerging prompting techniques and apply them to live products. Work closely with product designers and developers on AI UX flows.
3+ years of experience working directly with LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama)
Deep understanding of prompt design patterns: few-shot, CoT, ReAct, etc.
Familiarity with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI
Strong analytical mindset with experience in prompt evaluation metrics
Excellent written communication skills in English
Bonus: experience with fine-tuning or RLHF workflows

Job Title: LLM Engineer

Job Type: Full time

Responsibilities
Work with LLMs such as GPT, Llama, Gemini, and other open-source or commercial models.
Develop and optimize prompts to improve model accuracy and response quality.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and embedding models.

Strong knowledge of Python programming.
